intro.en: Vectors are lists of numbers that describe a direction and a size. In machine learning every data point and every word embedding is a vector, so vectors are the starting point of linear algebra.
intro.ru: Vectors numbers ki list hain jo simt aur size batati hain. Machine learning mein har data point aur har word embedding ek vector hai, is liye linear algebra vectors se shuru hota hai.

definition.en: A vector in R^n is an ordered list of n real numbers. Vectors can be added component-wise and scaled by numbers\; the dot product u . v = sum of u_i v_i measures how much two vectors point in the same direction.
definition.ru: R^n mein vector n real numbers ki tarteeb wali list hai. Vectors ko component by component jama kiya ja sakta hai aur numbers se scale kiya ja sakta hai\; dot product u . v = u_i v_i ka sum batata hai ke do vectors kitna ek hi simt mein hain.

explanation.en: Geometrically a vector is an arrow from the origin. Adding vectors places arrows tip to tail\; multiplying by a scalar stretches or flips the arrow. The length (norm) of v is sqrt(v . v). The dot product also equals ||u|| ||v|| cos(theta), so it is positive when the angle is less than 90 degrees, zero when the vectors are perpendicular (orthogonal) and negative when they point apart. Dividing a vector by its length gives a unit vector in the same direction. The projection of u onto v, (u . v / v . v) v, is the shadow of u on the line of v. A linear combination a u + b v combines vectors with scalar weights - the idea behind span and basis.
explanation.ru: Geometry mein vector origin se nikalta hua teer hai. Vectors jama karne mein teer ek ke sire par doosra rakhte hain\; scalar se zarab teer ko lamba ya ulta karta hai. v ki length (norm) sqrt(v . v) hai. Dot product ||u|| ||v|| cos(theta) ke barabar bhi hai, is liye angle 90 degree se kam ho to positive, perpendicular (orthogonal) hon to zero aur mukhalif simt mein hon to manfi hota hai. Vector ko us ki length se taqseem karne se usi simt ka unit vector milta hai. u ka v par projection, (u . v / v . v) v, v ki line par u ka saya hai. Linear combination a u + b v vectors ko scalar weights ke saath jorta hai - span aur basis ka idea yahi hai.

example.en: u = (3, 4), v = (4, -3). u + v = (7, 1)\; 2u = (6, 8)\; ||u|| = sqrt(9 + 16) = 5\; u . v = 12 - 12 = 0, so u and v are orthogonal. The unit vector of u is (0.6, 0.8).
example.ru: u = (3, 4), v = (4, -3). u + v = (7, 1)\; 2u = (6, 8)\; ||u|| = sqrt(9 + 16) = 5\; u . v = 12 - 12 = 0, yaani u aur v orthogonal hain. u ka unit vector (0.6, 0.8) hai.

intro.en: Matrices are tables of numbers. In machine learning a whole dataset is a matrix (rows = examples, columns = features) and most computations - from linear regression to neural networks - are matrix operations.
intro.ru: Matrices numbers ke tables hain. Machine learning mein poora dataset ek matrix hota hai (rows = examples, columns = features) aur zyada tar hisaab - linear regression se neural networks tak - matrix operations hi hain.

definition.en: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with m rows and n columns (an m x n matrix). Matrices can be added (same size), multiplied (inner sizes must match), transposed, and - if square and non-singular - inverted.
definition.ru: Matrix numbers ki m rows aur n columns wali mustateel (rectangular) tarteeb hai (m x n matrix). Matrices jama ho sakti hain (ek hi size), zarab ho sakti hain (andar wale sizes barabar hon), transpose ho sakti hain, aur agar square aur non-singular hon to un ka inverse nikal sakta hai.

explanation.en: To multiply A (m x n) by B (n x p), each entry of the result C (m x p) is the dot product of a row of A with a column of B: C[i][j] = sum over k of A[i][k] x B[k][j]. Matrix multiplication is not commutative: AB is usually different from BA. The transpose flips rows and columns. The determinant of a 2 x 2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] is ad - bc; if it is 0 the matrix has no inverse (it is singular). The inverse of a 2 x 2 matrix is (1/det) [[d, -b], [-c, a]], and A times its inverse gives the identity matrix. In ML, the normal equation of linear regression w = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y uses exactly these operations.
explanation.ru: A (m x n) ko B (n x p) se zarab karne par natije C (m x p) ka har element A ki ek row aur B ke ek column ka dot product hota hai: C[i][j] = sum (k par) A[i][k] x B[k][j]. Matrix multiplication commutative nahi: AB aam taur par BA se mukhtalif hota hai. Transpose rows aur columns ko palat deta hai. 2 x 2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] ka determinant ad - bc hai; agar yeh 0 ho to inverse nahi hota (singular). 2 x 2 ka inverse (1/det) [[d, -b], [-c, a]] hai, aur A ko us ke inverse se zarab karne par identity matrix aati hai. ML mein linear regression ki normal equation w = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y bilkul yahi operations istemal karti hai.

title.ru: Linear Equations ke Systems aur Gaussian Elimination

subject: Linear Algebra

solving systems of linear equations augmented matrix

intro.en: Many problems - from circuits to fitting a regression line - end in several linear equations that must hold at once. Gaussian elimination is the systematic way to solve them.
intro.ru: Bohat se masail - circuits se le kar regression line fit karne tak - kai linear equations par khatam hote hain jo ek saath sahi honi chahiyein. Gaussian elimination inhein hal karne ka munazzam tareeqa hai.

definition.en: Gaussian elimination solves Ax = b by applying elementary row operations to the augmented matrix [A | b] until it is in row echelon form, then using back substitution. Gauss-Jordan elimination continues to reduced row echelon form (RREF), where the solution can be read directly.
definition.ru: Gaussian elimination Ax = b ko augmented matrix [A | b] par elementary row operations laga kar hal karta hai jab tak woh row echelon form mein na aa jaye, phir back substitution. Gauss-Jordan elimination reduced row echelon form (RREF) tak jata hai, jahan hal seedha parha ja sakta hai.

explanation.en: The three elementary row operations - swap two rows, multiply a row by a non-zero number, add a multiple of one row to another - do not change the solution set. In echelon form each leading entry (pivot) is to the right of the one above and below it there are only zeros. A system can have exactly one solution (a pivot in every variable column), infinitely many (free variables) or none (a row like [0 0 0 | 5]). For a square A, exactly one solution exists if and only if det(A) is not 0. The number of pivots is the rank of A.
explanation.ru: Teen elementary row operations - do rows ki jagah badalna, ek row ko non-zero number se zarab karna, ek row ka multiple doosri mein jama karna - hal ka set nahi badaltin. Echelon form mein har leading entry (pivot) upar wale pivot se daayen hoti hai aur us ke neeche sirf zero hote hain. System ka bilkul ek hal ho sakta hai (har variable column mein pivot), be-shumar hal (free variables) ya koi hal nahi ([0 0 0 | 5] jaisi row). Square A ke liye bilkul ek hal tabhi hai jab det(A) zero na ho. Pivots ki tadaad A ka rank hai.

example.en: x + y = 3 and 2x - y = 0. Augmented [[1, 1 | 3], [2, -1 | 0]]. R2 = R2 - 2R1 gives [0, -3 | -6], so y = 2. Back substitution: x = 3 - 2 = 1. Solution (x, y) = (1, 2).
example.ru: x + y = 3 aur 2x - y = 0. Augmented [[1, 1 | 3], [2, -1 | 0]]. R2 = R2 - 2R1 se [0, -3 | -6], yaani y = 2. Back substitution: x = 3 - 2 = 1. Hal (x, y) = (1, 2).

title.en: Span, Basis, Rank and Linear Independence
title.ru: Span, Basis, Rank aur Linear Independence

subject: Linear Algebra
search_query: span basis linear independence rank vector space
video_queries: linear combinations span and basis vectors essence of linear algebra
linear independence rank null space lecture

intro.en: Which vectors can we build from a given set, and how many of them do we really need? Span, basis and rank answer these questions and describe the 'size' of a vector space.
intro.ru: Diye gaye vectors se kaun se vectors ban sakte hain, aur waqai kitne zaroori hain? Span, basis aur rank in sawalon ke jawab dete hain aur vector space ka 'size' batate hain.

definition.en: The span of a set of vectors is the set of all their linear combinations. Vectors are linearly independent if none of them is a combination of the others. A basis is an independent set that spans the space\; the number of basis vectors is the dimension, and the rank of a matrix is the dimension of its column space.
definition.ru: Vectors ke set ka span un ke tamam linear combinations ka set hai. Vectors linearly independent hain agar koi bhi baqi ka combination na ho. Basis aisa independent set hai jo poori space span kare\; basis vectors ki tadaad dimension hai, aur matrix ka rank us ki column space ki dimension hai.

explanation.en: Two non-parallel vectors in R^2 span the whole plane\; two parallel vectors only span a line. To test independence, put the vectors as columns of a matrix and row reduce: they are independent exactly when every column has a pivot. The rank equals the number of pivots. The rank-nullity theorem says rank + nullity = number of columns, where nullity is the dimension of the null space (solutions of A x = 0). A square n x n matrix is invertible exactly when its rank is n, its columns are independent and its determinant is non-zero - these are equivalent statements.
explanation.ru: R^2 mein do ghair-mutawazi (non-parallel) vectors poora plane span karte hain\; do mutawazi vectors sirf ek line. Independence check karne ke liye vectors ko matrix ke columns bana kar row reduce karein: woh tabhi independent hain jab har column mein pivot ho. Rank pivots ki tadaad ke barabar hai. Rank-nullity theorem kehta hai rank + nullity = columns ki tadaad, jahan nullity null space (A x = 0 ke hal) ki dimension hai. Square n x n matrix tabhi invertible hai jab us ka rank n ho, columns independent hon aur determinant non-zero ho - yeh sab ek hi baat hain.

example.en: Vectors (1, 2), (2, 4) are dependent because (2, 4) = 2 (1, 2)\; they span only a line. Vectors (1, 0), (1, 1) are independent and form a basis of R^2: any (a, b) = (a - b)(1, 0) + b (1, 1).
example.ru: Vectors (1, 2), (2, 4) dependent hain kyunki (2, 4) = 2 (1, 2)\; yeh sirf ek line span karte hain. Vectors (1, 0), (1, 1) independent hain aur R^2 ka basis hain: har (a, b) = (a - b)(1, 0) + b (1, 1).

video_queries: linear transformations and matrices essence of linear algebra
matrix multiplication as composition linear transformations

intro.en: Every matrix is a machine that moves vectors: it can rotate, stretch, shear or flip space. Seeing matrices as transformations makes matrix multiplication and determinants intuitive.
intro.ru: Har matrix vectors ko hilane wali machine hai: yeh space ko ghuma, khench, tedha (shear) ya ulta kar sakti hai. Matrices ko transformations ke taur par dekhne se matrix multiplication aur determinant aasan samajh aate hain.

definition.en: A transformation T is linear if T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v) and T(c u) = c T(u). Every linear transformation of R^n can be written as multiplication by a matrix whose columns are the images of the basis vectors.
definition.ru: Transformation T linear hai agar T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v) aur T(c u) = c T(u). R^n ki har linear transformation ek matrix se zarab ke taur par likhi ja sakti hai jis ke columns basis vectors ki images hain.

explanation.en: In 2-D, a matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] sends the basis vector i = (1, 0) to its first column (a, c) and j = (0, 1) to its second column (b, d)\; every other vector follows because of linearity. A rotation by angle theta is [[cos, -sin], [sin, cos]]\; a scaling is a diagonal matrix\; a shear is [[1, k], [0, 1]]. Applying transformation B and then A equals multiplying by A B, which is why matrix multiplication is not commutative (rotating then shearing differs from shearing then rotating). The absolute determinant is the factor by which areas are scaled\; a negative determinant means orientation is flipped, and determinant 0 means space is squashed onto a line or point.
explanation.ru: 2-D mein matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] basis vector i = (1, 0) ko apne pehle column (a, c) aur j = (0, 1) ko doosre column (b, d) par bhejti hai\; baqi har vector linearity ki wajah se peeche chalta hai. Angle theta ki rotation [[cos, -sin], [sin, cos]] hai\; scaling diagonal matrix hai\; shear [[1, k], [0, 1]] hai. Pehle B aur phir A lagana A B se zarab ke barabar hai, isi liye matrix multiplication commutative nahi (pehle ghumana phir shear karna, pehle shear phir ghumane se mukhtalif hai). Determinant ki absolute value batati hai areas kitne guna hote hain\; manfi determinant ka matlab orientation ulat gayi, aur determinant 0 ka matlab space ek line ya point par dab gayi.

example.en: Rotate (1, 0) by 90 degrees: the matrix [[0, -1], [1, 0]] gives (0, 1). Shear [[1, 1], [0, 1]] sends (0, 1) to (1, 1) but keeps (1, 0) fixed. Its determinant is 1, so areas are unchanged.

how to find eigenvalues and eigenvectors 2x2 matrix example

intro.en: Most vectors change direction when a matrix acts on them. Eigenvectors are the special directions that are only stretched. They power PCA, PageRank and the analysis of dynamic systems.
intro.ru: Zyada tar vectors matrix lagne par apni simt badal lete hain. Eigenvectors woh khaas simtein hain jo sirf khenchti hain. PCA, PageRank aur dynamic systems ka tajziya inhi par chalta hai.

definition.en: A non-zero vector v is an eigenvector of a square matrix A with eigenvalue lambda if A v = lambda v. Eigenvalues are the roots of the characteristic equation det(A - lambda I) = 0.
definition.ru: Non-zero vector v square matrix A ka eigenvector hai jis ki eigenvalue lambda hai agar A v = lambda v. Eigenvalues characteristic equation det(A - lambda I) = 0 ke roots hain.

explanation.en: To find them: form A - lambda I, set its determinant to zero, solve for lambda, then for each lambda solve (A - lambda I) v = 0 for the eigenvectors. For a 2 x 2 matrix the characteristic equation is lambda^2 - trace(A) lambda + det(A) = 0, so the eigenvalues add up to the trace and multiply to the determinant. If an n x n matrix has n independent eigenvectors it can be diagonalised: A = P D P^-1, where D holds the eigenvalues\; powers become easy (A^k = P D^k P^-1). Symmetric matrices have real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenvectors - the basis of PCA, where the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix are the principal directions.
explanation.ru: Nikalne ke liye: A - lambda I banayein, us ka determinant zero rakhein, lambda hal karein, phir har lambda ke liye (A - lambda I) v = 0 se eigenvectors nikalein. 2 x 2 matrix ke liye characteristic equation lambda^2 - trace(A) lambda + det(A) = 0 hai, is liye eigenvalues ka sum trace aur zarab determinant ke barabar hai. Agar n x n matrix ke n independent eigenvectors hon to use diagonalise kiya ja sakta hai: A = P D P^-1, jahan D mein eigenvalues hain\; powers aasan ho jati hain (A^k = P D^k P^-1). Symmetric matrices ki eigenvalues real aur eigenvectors orthogonal hote hain - yahi PCA ki buniyad hai, jahan covariance matrix ke eigenvectors principal simtein hain.

example.en: A = [[2, 1], [1, 2]]. trace = 4, det = 3, so lambda^2 - 4 lambda + 3 = 0 and lambda = 1 or 3. For lambda = 3: (A - 3I) = [[-1, 1], [1, -1]], so v = (1, 1). For lambda = 1: v = (1, -1). Check: A (1, 1) = (3, 3) = 3 (1, 1).
example.ru: A = [[2, 1], [1, 2]]. trace = 4, det = 3, to lambda^2 - 4 lambda + 3 = 0 aur lambda = 1 ya 3. lambda = 3 ke liye: (A - 3I) = [[-1, 1], [1, -1]], to v = (1, 1). lambda = 1 ke liye v = (1, -1). Check: A (1, 1) = (3, 3) = 3 (1, 1).
